Ho Chi Minh To Tay Ninh Private Car is a smart choice for traveling quickly and safely to Tay Ninh City when you stay in Saigon. Whether you book our private car service for tourism or business purposes, our experienced drivers will pick you up and drop you off door-to-door in a modern car with comfortable seats.

Good Reasons To Choose Us

  • Flexibility: Customers can customize their itinerary to best suit their travel plans. In addition, you can ask our friendly driver to stop along the way if you need to eat, sightsee, or enjoy Vietnamese coffee.
  • Convenience: Our private car will pick you up door-to-door with a skilled driver at your requested pick-up time and location.
  • Good Price: We provide services at prices suitable for many customer groups and prices are publicly disclosed in the article.
  • Payment Methods: With the rapid advancement of digital technology, we offer many online payment methods, including bank transfers, credit cards, and PayPal.
  • Experienced Drivers Team: The team of drivers is selected based on high criteria such as customer friendliness, many years of driving experience, and familiarity with the routes.
  • Professional Operations Staff: Our consultants are available on WhatsApp 24/7 to promptly support you when needed.

HO CHI MINH TO TAY NINH BY CAR TRANSFER

Ho Chi Minh City To Tay Ninh Distance

The distance from Saigon to Tay Ninh City is approximately 88 km, and traveling one way by car typically takes about two and a half hours. However, Saigon’s dense population often leads to traffic congestion, especially during peak hours. As a result, depending on the traffic conditions and the place you are staying, the actual travel time could be significantly longer.

Nowadays, tourists have various transportation options between the two locations, including coaches, buses, shared cars, and private cars. However, business travelers and foreign visitors with young children often prefer our private car service. This option offers privacy and flexibility to schedule.

Private Car Ho Chi Minh City To Tay Ninh

Customers can access and book our private car service via WhatsApp or Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588 or Booking Form. Immediately after receiving your booking request, our staff will respond and exchange some information before confirming it.

On the departure date, our private car will pick you up at your requested location, such as a hotel, resort, or Tan Son Nhat International Airport (Saigon Airport). For crowded pickup points like the airport, our experienced driver will carry a nameplate so you can easily find him. After the meeting, he will take you to the car and start the Ho Chi Minh To Tay Ninh by car.

Along the way, visitors can ask our driver to stop the car if they need to eat, sightsee, or use the restroom. He will be pleased to select a stop that meets your needs.

When you arrive in Tay Ninh City, our private car will drop you off at your requested hotel address. Next, he will help you get your luggage and check his car carefully before bidding farewell. Finally, our Private Car Saigon To Tay Ninh ends. Vietlook Travel is delighted to travel with you.

Travel Thoughts

  • Please check your passport and relevant travel documents before leaving your hotel in Saigon.
  • For pick-up points at Saigon Airport, please inform us if your flight schedule changes, and we will arrange a private car to pick you up on time.
  • Customers who want to return to Saigon the same day after using our private car service for a business trip in Tay Ninh City, please let our travel expert know when booking.
